identity.name: Compass Coffee — former Logan Circle cafe
identity.notes: The requested Logan Circle cafe at 1924 14th Street NW closed in January 2026 and is absent from Compass Coffee's current official 16-cafe locator. The frozen source is a separate live Uber storefront at 849 18th Street NW, not Logan Circle. Current corporate ordering identifies the surviving chain as Compass Coffee By Caffè Nero; chain evidence is retained only in explicitly chain-scoped surfaces.

sources.excerpt: Current corporate homepage identifies Compass Coffee, links the official cafe locator and branded ordering application, and presents current retail coffee products.

Fresh complete official locator inspection lists 16 current Compass Coffee cafes, including Shaw and Dupont, but no Logan Circle or 1924 14th Street location. Current ordering brands the locations Compass Coffee By Caffè Nero.

Current corporate FAQ says breakfast sandwiches are available at all cafes and that cafes offer pastries and grab-and-go snacks. It discusses drink customization, coffee carriers, and Kosher certification but publishes no allergen matrix.

Current official customization guidance says non-dairy milk substitutions are available without an extra charge and lists year-round flavor options. This is substitution guidance, not an allergen absence or cross-contact guarantee.

Fresh complete All Items inspection for current Shaw, 1535 7th St NW, inventoried 77 unique food, nonalcoholic drink, and edible retail products across all 10 categories, with direct ingredient descriptions.
Fresh complete All Items inspection for current Dupont, 2150 P St NW, produced the same 77-product, 10-category inventory as Shaw. Out-of-stock entries were retained as current catalog products.

Fresh complete official All Coffee collection inspection, including all View More pages, inventoried 49 current packaged coffee and capsule products. Tasting notes such as milk chocolate or toasted nuts were not treated as ingredient or allergen claims.

The frozen Uber storefront remains live at 849 18th Street NW with a broad menu, but that address is neither the requested former Logan Circle cafe nor a current official-locator entry. Its exclusive products are excluded from the current union.
Contemporaneous January 2026 closure reporting lists Compass Coffee's 1924 14th Street NW cafe among the locations closed during the chain's restructuring.

Fresh official-domain searches for allergen, allergy, nutrition, ingredients, PDFs, and downloadable guides found no current product-by-allergen matrix or Compass Coffee cross-contact document. Results for Compass Group and third-party restaurants serving Compass coffee were excluded.
Fresh exact-brand, exact-address, and broader targeted searches corroborated the Logan closure and found no current authoritative all-allergen matrix for Compass Coffee.

reconciliation.notes: All 73 frozen rows are represented exactly once as location mismatches because the packet requested the closed Logan Circle cafe while the frozen source is the separate 849 18th Street storefront. 60 rows have pairwise current corporate-product context; unsupported 849-only or retired/accessory rows remain unmapped and are not imported.

findings.summary: The requested Compass Coffee Logan Circle cafe at 1924 14th Street NW closed in January 2026 and is absent from the current official locator.
All 73 frozen rows came from a live Uber storefront at 849 18th Street NW, not the requested Logan Circle cafe. The two addresses and surfaces must not be merged.

Current chain context contains 77 products identically present in complete Shaw and Dupont ordering menus plus 49 products in the complete official All Coffee collection. These products are not assigned to the closed Logan location, and 849-only products are excluded.

No current Compass Coffee product-by-allergen matrix or cross-contact guide was found after all four required searches. Current direct positives are limited to ingredients named in the two matching cafe menus.
Current official ordering and locator surfaces identify surviving locations as Compass Coffee By Caffè Nero; this corporate transition does not reopen or replace the former Logan cafe.

routingSignals: Requested Logan Circle cafe confirmed closed
Frozen menu source belongs to 849 18th Street, not Logan Circle
Chain-wide context retained only on explicitly scoped complete current surfaces
Current allergen matrix accurately unavailable after all four searches
proposedChanges: Mark the Logan Circle cafe closed and remove all current-product assignments from its location surface.
Treat all 73 frozen 849 18th Street rows as location mismatches; retain pairwise mappings only as current corporate context.
Keep the identical complete Shaw/Dupont 77-product menu and complete 49-product All Coffee collection explicitly chain-scoped, without transferring 849-only products.
Retain only direct allergens named by current shared-menu ingredient descriptions; treat non-dairy substitutions as customization guidance and absent allergen fields as unavailable.
